title: Winning captains 2003 to 2012
brief: Name the captain of the Champions League winners in each final from 2003 to 2012: the player who wore the armband at kick-off.

notes.Didier Deschamps: Didier Deschamps captained the winners in 1993, outside this board's years.
notes.Mauro Tassotti: Mauro Tassotti captained the winners in 1994, outside this board's years.
notes.Danny Blind: Danny Blind captained the winners in 1995, outside this board's years.
notes.Gianluca Vialli: Gianluca Vialli captained the winners in 1996, outside this board's years.
notes.Matthias Sammer: Matthias Sammer captained the winners in 1997, outside this board's years.
notes.Manolo Sanchis: Manolo Sanchis captained the winners in 1998, outside this board's years.
notes.Peter Schmeichel: Peter Schmeichel captained the winners in 1999, outside this board's years.
notes.Fernando Redondo: Fernando Redondo captained the winners in 2000, outside this board's years.
notes.Stefan Effenberg: Stefan Effenberg captained the winners in 2001, outside this board's years.
notes.Fernando Hierro: Fernando Hierro captained the winners in 2002, outside this board's years.
notes.Philipp Lahm: Philipp Lahm captained the winners in 2013, outside this board's years.
notes.Iker Casillas: Iker Casillas captained the winners in 2014, outside this board's years.
notes.Andres Iniesta: Andres Iniesta captained the winners in 2015, outside this board's years.
notes.Sergio Ramos: Sergio Ramos captained the winners in 2016 and 2017 and 2018, outside this board's years.
notes.Jordan Henderson: Jordan Henderson captained the winners in 2019, outside this board's years.
notes.Manuel Neuer: Manuel Neuer captained the winners in 2020, outside this board's years.
notes.Cesar Azpilicueta: Cesar Azpilicueta captained the winners in 2021, outside this board's years.
notes.Karim Benzema: Karim Benzema captained the winners in 2022, outside this board's years.
notes.Ilkay Gundogan: Ilkay Gundogan captained the winners in 2023, outside this board's years.
notes.Nacho: Nacho captained the winners in 2024, outside this board's years.
notes.Marquinhos: Marquinhos captained the winners in 2025 and 2026, outside this board's years.
notes.Rio Ferdinand: Rio Ferdinand captained Man Utd in the 2008 final and lifted the trophy with Ryan Giggs, who came on.
notes.Xavi: Xavi started the 2011 final as Barcelona captain; Carles Puyol came on late and Eric Abidal lifted the trophy.
notes.Frank Lampard: Frank Lampard captained Chelsea in the 2012 final because John Terry was suspended.
notes.Carles Puyol: Puyol came on in the 2011 final, but Xavi started it as captain.
notes.Eric Abidal: Abidal lifted the trophy in 2011, but Xavi was Barcelona's captain on the team sheet.
notes.Ryan Giggs: Giggs lifted the trophy with Rio Ferdinand in 2008, but Ferdinand started the final as captain.
notes.John Terry: Terry was suspended for the 2012 final; Lampard captained Chelsea.

sources: Transfermarkt final match reports (captain's armband on the line-up), ids in cl_finals_1993_2026.csv
checks: Captain read from the (c) mark on each final's Wikipedia team sheet and from the captain's armband icon on each Transfermarkt match report; the two agree for every final in the window. No player or club fills four slots.
